description: The topic sets mode corpora draw from. The twenty topics of set_a and set_b, crossed with five modes at num_repetitions each, give a corpus of 200 generations.

vmb_stage0_strata.description: The floor protocol: the twenty topics of set_a and set_b under four task strata, 80 prompt classes of seeds_per_class seeds each, sampled with no system prompt so the floor is measured bare. Stratum order is fixed: a banked floor corpus lays out its generation ids by stratum index, and the faithfulness set takes each topic's continuation from the stratum that index names (anamnesis.analysis.battery.stage0.floor_gid). The conversational template embeds the topic mid-sentence verbatim, capitalization untouched, so every topic is framed the same way.
